title: Fleet overview
description: Fleet manager health: Tasks, sessions, reconciles, effects and runtime calls.

list.name: job
list.label: Fleet
list.description: The Prometheus job of a Fleet manager: service.namespace/service.name, or the scrape job.

panels.title: Reconciles per second
panels.description: Object reconciles per second over all controllers. Zero means the manager stopped sweeping.

panels.title: Reconcile errors
panels.description: Reconciles that ended in error or lost the manager lease, over the range.

panels.title: Failed effects
panels.description: Effects whose outcome was failed, over the range.

panels.title: Unknown effect outcomes
panels.description: Effects Fleet could not observe the outcome of. Fleet recovers them by observing their key.

panels.title: Inbox entries waiting
panels.description: Undelivered inbox entries over every Task, at the start of the latest pass.

panels.title: Forge throttles
panels.description: Change polls a forge throttled, over the range.

panels.title: Stalled Tasks
panels.description: Tasks whose session stopped making progress, at the start of the latest pass.

panels.title: Releasing Tasks
panels.description: Tasks Fleet is releasing, at the start of the latest pass.

panels.title: Lost sessions
panels.description: Task sessions the runtime proved lost, at the start of the latest pass.

panels.title: Paused sessions
panels.description: Task sessions paused, at the start of the latest pass.

panels.title: Tasks by phase
panels.description: Tasks in each phase at the start of each pass. Concluded Tasks stay until they are released.

panels.title: Sessions by state
panels.description: Task sessions in each state at the start of each pass.

panels.title: Tasks spawned
panels.description: Task sessions started or adopted, over the range.

panels.title: Tasks briefed
panels.description: Task briefs sent, over the range.

panels.title: Tasks released
panels.description: Tasks whose release was established, over the range.

panels.title: Reconciles by controller
panels.description: Object reconciles per second, per controller.

panels.title: Reconciles by outcome
panels.description: changed: the reconcile wrote or ran an effect. conflict, error and leaseLost need attention when they persist.

panels.title: Mean reconcile duration by controller
panels.description: Mean of one object's reconcile. Fleet records this histogram on the SDK's default bucket bounds, which are millisecond-scale, so quantiles from its buckets are wrong. Use the Fleet traces dashboard for p50/p95.

panels.title: Reconcile problems
panels.description: Reconciles per second that ended in error, conflict or leaseLost.

panels.title: Effects by kind and outcome
panels.description: External effects per second, by kind and outcome.

panels.title: Effects over the range
panels.description: Effects by kind and outcome over the dashboard range.

targets.expr: sum by (fleet_effect, fleet_outcome) ((((fleet_effects_total{job=~"$job"}) * 1) unless (fleet_effects_total{job=~"$job"} offset $__range)) or increase(fleet_effects_total{job=~"$job"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Runtime calls by verb and outcome
panels.description: Runtime protocol calls per second. unknown is a call that failed: the program did not start, timed out, exited non-zero or answered Unknown.

panels.title: Mean runtime call duration by verb
panels.description: Mean of one runtime protocol call, per verb.
